object.description: In a repository holding documents DOC and PARENT, leave conflict markers in one of DOC's object files and list the repository's documents. Separately, put a folder named like an object file (objects/DOC-9.xml) in DOC, standing for a file that can't be opened, and read the repository, then read DOC twice. Expected: DOC is still listed, with a load error, and PARENT reads normally; reading DOC itself fails with a message saying the file can't be read, on each read.
